note: Post-freeze inputs of scripts/robotangle/release_rebuild.py --manifest (docs/rcb/HARBOR_FREEZE_RUNBOOK.md). Copy this file next to the references (e.g. host A tmp/<date>_harbor_release/freeze.json), fill it in, run. head: the frozen dev/robotangle_mujoco commit; version: the image version (images/<bench>/VERSION); bench: the benchmark (default robotangle-new; release_rebuild.py --bench); onto: the main-based commit whose mk_tasks.py renders MuJoCo bases (branch qineng-rt-mj-harbor-main rebased on main); families: the subset of mujoco_release.json to rebuild (all when absent); hf_revision: the dataset commit holding this run's uploaded instances (second run only); gpu: the device index for GPU-profile bases. bases: one entry per new base name that mujoco_release.json lists: reference = the recorded privileged.npz (relative to this file), sha256 = its sha256 (checked), expect = the end state the recording reached (prefix of state_sha; the report compares the Harbor oracle's end states with it), step_s = wall seconds per control step of the recording on the trial host class (only if the user OKs stating it; default: omit, the released sentence stays), instance = a made instance directory to use instead of making it (only for a family whose instance is not made by make-instance; the report marks it).
head: <frozen dev/robotangle_mujoco sha>
